about.title: About MazdoorPK
about.p1: MazdoorPK is a free platform built for Pakistan, connecting customers with local workers — mistri, mazdoor, plumber, electrician, AC technician, cleaner, sofa cleaner, safai wali, gardener, cook, driver, tailor and many more.
about.p2: We do not charge any commission. We do not take bookings. You contact the worker directly by phone or WhatsApp.
about.p3: Our mission is to help skilled workers across Pakistan get more customers without paying middlemen.

how.title: How It Works
how.step1: Choose your city and the service you need.
how.step2: Browse local workers and see their rates.
how.step3: Call or WhatsApp them directly — no booking fee.
how.wStep2: Add your services, city, area, rate and phone number.
how.wStep3: Customers find you and call you directly — keep 100% of your earnings.
